deep_analysis:
MARKET: BTC is pinned AT EMA300 for ~149 consecutive minutes (precheck advisory verbatim: "chop pin, mid-band entries have no edge — wait for resolution"). Since 15:36 the 1m closes straddle the line every 1-3 candles (81610-81737 vs EMA 81610-81670 over the last 40m) — neither holding above nor below. Continuum: position AT, linreg_direction LEAN_BEAR (15m and 1h slopes negative, 1m/5m flat), volume LOW, volatility LOW. Auto-trader agrees: CHOP / BRACKET for 6 straight cycles (score long -20, short +10). No trend, no fuel — the "trend is your friend" rule says there is no edge on either side AT the pin.

BOOK: 1 open — AVAX LONG 16371, -0.41% (9.094 at 16:16 vs entry 9.1311 at 14:55). WOULD NOT OPEN FRESH, three reasons: (1) signal r2v2-long4 is 0W/4L closed (-0.27 USDT) and this is attempt #5, entered at meta_rsi 72.8 — the chase-after-the-pop profile of all four losers; (2) AVAX 5m regime is SHORT_BIAS conf 53.8 — we hold the long against the coin's own tape; (3) MFE in 82 minutes was +0.075% (9.138 at 16:04) — the trail at +0.40% never had a chance to arm, and price has printed lower highs all session (9.179 at 14:50 -> 9.138 at 16:04 -> 9.091 at 16:14). WINNING SIDE: short AVAX — someone has been selling every rally in this coin all afternoon and getting paid.

RETRACTION (mandatory rule): prior cycle's 15:20 urgent steer "exit AVAX while BTC 1m holds below EMA300 (81703)" is RETRACTED — condition reversed at ~15:36 when BTC reclaimed EMA300; continuum position is AT at write and the 1m has straddled for 40+ min. Re-issuing that text would be an exit on reverted evidence. age=0 — it was never executed and it is now withdrawn.

STEER (warning, condition-keyed): Exit AVAX LONG 16371 on any 1m close below 9.072 (the 15:35-15:45 post-entry swing-low band, verified from candles.db at write: last 1m close 9.094 at 16:16 — condition FALSE, still holding above). Above that line the SL at 8.994 stays the backstop and the position costs nothing but time; below it the weak entry thesis is structurally dead and the next stop is the SL anyway. Re-test both the condition and trade PnL next cycle.

STEER (info): WCT SHORT watchlist pick from 15:20 (0.03688) — its own stated invalidation FIRED: WCT printed 5m highs above the 0.037713 trigger starting 16:06 and last traded 0.03864, +4.8% adverse. It never executed (AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False) and that was the correct outcome — a mid-band short (RSI 55.5) in the exact band that loses. Superseded by this cycle's pick; logged as a validated near-miss, not a signal.

Exposure: 1 long / 0 short. Aggregate regime has churned SHORT_BIAS (16:00) -> LONG_BIAS (16:15) inside the last hour, so no snapshot direction claim is cheap right now (see regime_context flip rate). What IS verifiable: our single position is a long on a coin with a SHORT_BIAS regime while 15m/1h linreg on BTC are both negative. Not urgent — the position is -0.41% with a defined stop — but it is the wrong side of both tapes.
regime_context:
SOURCES NAMED (they disagree; source before direction):
- watchdog regime_summary 16:14: btc_15m SHORT_BIAS, btc_4h LONG_BIAS, continuum AT, volatility LOW, trend_quality STRONG_UP, velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE, volume LOW.
- continuum 1m (written 16:07-16:14): BTC price AT EMA300, ema300_duration ~149m (pin), linreg_direction LEAN_BEAR (15m/1h negative, 1m/5m flat), market_phase CALM, trend_quality STRONG_UP — the trend_quality vs linreg fields contradict each other; neither is traded on without the price-vs-EMA fact, which says AT.
- regime_5m 16:00: aggregate SHORT_BIAS (30 short / 12 long / 81 neutral of 123); BTC token NEUTRAL conf 45.9; AVAX token SHORT_BIAS conf 53.8. The 16:15 dump flipped aggregate to LONG_BIAS.
- auto_trader: CHOP for 6 consecutive cycles, BRACKET both sides, price 81626.

FLIP RATE (measured this cycle from logs/15m_regime.log, 96 dumps): aggregate 30 flips/24h — >= p95(26), UNUSUALLY UNSTABLE. BTC 15m 18 flips/24h — baseline normal (p50 20). The old ">=6 = high churn" line is vestigial and is NOT a finding (satisfied on 100% of the last 14d). At 30 flips/24h the aggregate direction state survives ~48 minutes on average — it has cycled NEUTRAL/SHORT/LONG/SHORT/LONG three times since 15:00 alone. Durable facts, in order: (1) BTC pinned AT EMA300 ~149m with no resolution, (2) 15m/1h linreg both negative (LEAN_BEAR), (3) volume and volatility LOW = no fuel for either direction. Any direction-flavored action is therefore condition-keyed to a re-tested level, never to a snapshot label.

P1 — SHORT RSI bands, 14 days, refined (sharpest verified edge on the book right now):
  meta_rsi <45:  n=35, 12W (34.3%), avg -0.0163
  meta_rsi 45-60: n=36, 7W (19.4%), avg -0.0317   <-- WORST band in the entire system
  meta_rsi 60-65: n=6, 3W, avg +0.0567
  meta_rsi >=65: n=8, 5W (62.5%), avg +0.0438
  WINNING SIDE: short strength at RSI >=60. The 45-60 mid-band is where signals fire after the dump has started — 19.4% WR, the most reliable loss generator we have. WHY WE WEREN'T ON IT: entries land 20-25 points below the top. Last 24h confirms exactly: all four volume-buildup- losses were rsi<45 entries (ALT 41.2 hard_max_loss, ME 35.1, ZRO 43.3 hard_max_loss, CC 38.1 stale_exit) and the single win was WLD at 70.49 -> trailed +0.11. This cycle's SYRUP watchlist SHORT sits at 59.3 — one point below the profitable band; flagged marginal in the pick itself.

P2 — LONG RSI bands, 14 days: <45 n=43 avg -0.0249; 45-60 n=91 (37.4% WR) avg -0.0225; 60-70 n=61 avg -0.0116; >=70 n=33 avg +0.0091. Second independent disproof of the "45-60 sweet spot" heuristic — 91 trades, negative average, and it was originally derived from the unreliable entry_rsi_14 column. Do not re-quote it. Only >=70 is non-losing, and barely.

P3 — r2v2-long4 (AVAX's signal): 0W/4L closed, total -0.27, prior entry RSIs 44.4/57.6/65.6/69.2; open AVAX is attempt #5 at 72.8. Pattern: buy after the pop, every time. WINNING SIDE: the fade — the short that comes after our stop. Do not add to this family.

P4 — volume-buildup- split (re-verified, identical to prior cycle): <45 n=9 4W avg -0.0500; 45-60 n=1 W avg +0.1100; >=60 n=6 5W avg +0.0617. Net signal is +0.03 across 16 trades ONLY because the >=60 half carries it. Band gate on entries = brain-auditor scope; watchdog does not edit signal code.

P5 — 24h book: 19 closed, 8W (42.1%), net -0.36 USDT. Exit machinery is healthy (profit-monster-trail, cut-loser, hard_max_loss, UNIVERSAL_MAX_HOLD all fired as designed); every loss was selected at entry, not mismanaged in the trade. One anomaly worth watching: bb-squeeze+ longs taken at meta_rsi 72-75 went 2W/1L today (HBAR +0.03, YGG +0.12, ME -0.05) while the same signal at rsi 65.3 (PUMP) lost — the >=70 long band in P2 is real but thin.
